class.name: ListUpdateCallback
class.brief_description: Abstract receiver of incremental list update events.
class.description: ListUpdateCallback is the port of [i]ListUpdateCallback[/i]: the sink that receives the insert / remove / move / change events produced by a diff. The RecyclerView-side implementations ([b]AdapterListUpdateCallback[/b], [b]BatchingListUpdateCallback[/b]) forward them into adapter notify calls. Subclass and override the [code]_on_*[/code] hooks to consume updates yourself.

method.name: _on_changed
method.description: Called when [code]count[/code] items at [code]position[/code] changed, with an optional payload.

method.name: _on_inserted
method.description: Called when items were inserted at [code]position[/code] / [code]count[/code].

method.name: _on_moved
method.description: Called when an item moved from [code]from_position[/code] to [code]to_position[/code].

method.name: _on_removed
method.description: Called when items were removed at [code]position[/code] / [code]count[/code].
